This vignette demonstrates the `clean_social()` pipeline for removing emoji,
normalizing accents, and mapping slang.

```{r}
library(portuNLP)
clean_social("gosto mt disto 😎", custom_map = c(mt = "muito"))
```

Each cleaning step can be used individually. For example, you can remove only
emoji or just apply the slang map:

```{r}
remove_emoji("olá 😊")
map_slang("tbm gosto", custom_map = c(tbm = "também"))
```

Combining all three operations ensures consistent text for further processing.
